# Khmer Lexicon Dist

This directory tracks the output of the lexicon builder scripts.

## Artifacts

* `unified_lexicon.json` - The full merged terminology resource.
* `unified_official_lexicon.json` - Identical to `unified_lexicon.json` currently.

## Metrics

* **Entry Count**: 5,932 terms
* **Sources merged**: 
  - `council-of-ministers-legal-terms`: **Council of Ministers - Law & Civil Procedure (2007)**
  - `mptc-digital-lexicon`: **Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (MPTC) - Digital Technology & Telecom (2025)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol10-2019`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 10 (2019)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol3-2010`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 3 (2010)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol4-2012`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 4 (2012)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol5-2013`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 5 (2013)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol7-2015`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 7 (2015)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol8-2017`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 8 (2017)**
  - `nckl-bulletin-vol9-2018`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Bulletin Vol 9 (2018)**
  - `nckl-country-and-city-names`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Geography (2013)**
  - `nckl-economics`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Economics (2019)**
  - `nckl-political-science-and-diplomacy`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Political Science & Diplomacy (2014)**
  - `nckl-technology-and-science`: **National Council of Khmer Language (NCKL) - Science, Tech & Mathematics (2014)**
  - `pentagonal-strategy-phase1`: **Royal Government of Cambodia - Pentagonal Strategy Phase 1 (2023)**
  - `rac-new-words`: **Royal Academy of Cambodia (National Language Institute) - General & New Words (2018)**

These artifacts are committed to ensure the combined lexicon is tracked and reproducible.
